visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit at a mahjong table in a brightly lit studio setting. One woman with reddish-brown hair and glasses looks intensely at the tiles while the other, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top, reacts with confusion. Their hand movements involve shifting white mahjong tiles around the green felt surface of the table. (2) A close-up reveals the mahjong tiles have purple markings visible through specialized glasses, suggesting a cheating scenario. One woman realizes she has been tricked. Facial expressions shift from suspicion to realization. Text overlays appear at the side indicating dramatic theatrical effects for the audience. (3) The scene shifts to a dark outdoor street at night under city lights. A woman in black walks quickly while looking at her phone. She meets another woman in a beige sweater. A white Suzuki Ignis car pulls up alongside them, and they get into the vehicle. (4) Inside the moving car, the woman in black drinks from a yellow 'Mai Xiang' milk tea carton using a straw. The driver is a young man wearing glasses. The lighting is low and cinematic, with streetlights flashing by the windows as the car travels through an urban area. (5) A high-speed chase ensues on an urban highway at night. A silver Tesla Model 3 pursues the white Suzuki. The woman in the back seat spills her milk tea due to the erratic movement and begins changing her clothes in the confined space. (6) A man leans out of the chasing car's window with an assault rifle, firing at the Suzuki. Window glass shatters dramatically across the frame. The women inside react with fear and urgency. The scene transitions through fast cuts and handheld shaky camera work. (7) Both cars stop abruptly under a highway overpass. Men with guns exit their vehicles. The women run toward a concrete wall. Visual energy effects like blue sparks appear as they seemingly use supernatural powers to repel the gunmen. (8) One woman seizes a gun from a fallen assailant. She gestures for her friend to leave. The friend gets into a white Tesla parked nearby and drives off quickly. The scene ends with a 'To be continued' title card followed by a full credit roll.
